response.sql:
SELECT
  t.MediaTypeId,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageTrackUnitPrice,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS RatioToOverallAverage
FROM Track AS t
GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY RatioToOverallAverage DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only media types represented by at least one track are included, because the grouping is over Track.MediaTypeId.
